answerable.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
answerable.text:
Full-time employees get **27 days** of annual leave plus UK bank holidays [1].

- **Service increase:** one extra day for every two years of service, up to a maximum of 32 days [1].
- **Carry-over:** up to five unused days can be carried into the next calendar year, but they expire on 31 March [1].

Halcyon Labs - Incident Response Runbook
This runbook is fictional sample content for the DocChat demo.
1. Severity levels
SEV1: FieldCast is unavailable for all customers, or forecasts are wrong
for more than 10% of fields. Page the on-call engineer immediately and
open an incident channel named #inc-<date>-<short-name>.
SEV2: A major feature is degraded (for example, SMS frost alerts are
delayed by more than 15 minutes). Page on-call during core hours only.
SEV3: Minor issue with a workaround. Raise a ticket; no page needed.

2. Roles during an incident
Incident Commander (IC): coordinates the response and makes decisions.
The IC does not debug; their job is communication and prioritisation.
Communications Lead: posts status page updates every 30 minutes for
SEV1 and every 60 minutes for SEV2.
Subject Matter Experts: investigate and fix, reporting to the IC.
3. Escalation
If the on-call engineer does not acknowledge a page within 5 minutes,
PagerDuty escalates to the secondary on-call. After 15 minutes it
escalates to the Head of Engineering, Priya Raman.

- **Grower**: £29 per month, up to 25 fields, 10-day forecasts, updated hourly, frost alerts by SMS.
- **Estate**: £149 per month, unlimited fields, 14-day forecasts, updated every 15 minutes, API access and a dedicated account manager.

Annual billing gives two months free on any paid plan.

answerable.question: Are there meetings on Fridays?
answerable.text:
**No internal meetings are held on Fridays.** Fridays are "focus Fridays", and Slack notifications are optional [1].

The regular meetings in the documents fall on other days:
- **Monthly planning:** each team meets in the Bristol office on the first Tuesday of every month [3].
- **Reliability meeting:** held every other Wednesday at 14:00 to review post-mortems [2].

The documents don't say whether external meetings, such as with customers, can happen on Fridays.

4. After the incident
Every SEV1 and SEV2 incident needs a blameless post-mortem, published
within 5 working days. The post-mortem must include a timeline, the
root cause, customer impact, and at least one follow-up action with an
owner and a due date.
Post-mortems are reviewed in the fortnightly reliability meeting,
held every other Wednesday at 14:00.
5. Customer credits
Estate customers receive a 10% service credit for any month in which
availability falls below 99.9%.

answerable.question: What counts as a SEV1 incident?

- FieldCast is unavailable for all customers [1]
- Forecasts are wrong for more than 10% of fields [1]

Incident Commander (IC): coordinates the response and makes decisions.

Communications Lead: posts status page updates every 30 minutes for
SEV1 and every 60 minutes for SEV2.
Subject Matter Experts: investigate and fix, reporting to the IC.
3. Escalation
If the on-call engineer does not acknowledge a page within 5 minutes,
PagerDuty escalates to the secondary on-call. After 15 minutes it
escalates to the Head of Engineering, Priya Raman.
